related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: Make environmental services accountable through evidence from real MNCS development, and make machine-native work easier to discover and carry out.

measurement_basis: Explicit link from the observed response-budget pressure to the committed Environment implementation and its regression and live-projection verification. The relation records integration-time verification separately from longer-term service effectiveness.
not_measured: whether the summary reduces agent intervention in ordinary development
whether other agents can discover, interpret, or use the information reliably
whether the 37 unknown or unavailable bindings represent eligible service opportunities
whether subsequent session activity changes these availability states
whether any MNCS-native implementation became feasible as a result

outcome.implementation_change: Environmental Capability Intelligence now derives a bounded provider-level availability summary from the current session binding snapshot and retains it through response-budget compaction, including provider declaration source pointers and explicit scan and omission status.
outcome.verified_change: The existing capability-intelligence test module passed all 194 tests, and a post-commit live ECI readback returned the summary within the CLI response limit.
outcome.interpretation_limit: This verifies the projection path and regression behavior. It does not prove agent receipt, discoverability, reduced intervention, or long-term resolution of the observed pressure.

improvement_relation.basis: The implementation preserves the current binding availability summary in response-priority views; targeted regression assertions cover provider reason counts, declaration source pointers, scan completeness, and the unestablished agent-receipt and service-opportunity states.
not_measured: agent-reported or independently observed intervention reduction
cross-session recurrence or long-term pressure resolution
whether any provider capability was needed for the selected work intent
whether the implementation changed native-versus-host ownership or migration readiness
